title: PROSPECTIVE replication: does the three-guild rate replicate on unseen seeds?
headline: **PREDICTION SUPPORTED** — the pre-registered outcome occurred. This is one cohort of one engine version on one seed panel; it is not independent validation.
prediction: PROSPECTIVE, stated before inspection: consumers > 0 on at least 12/18, AND all three guilds non-zero on at most 8/18. The first clause asserts consumer viability replicates; the second asserts the BALANCE shortfall replicates rather than being an artefact of the old panel.
falsification: FALSIFIED if consumers > 0 on fewer than 12/18 (consumer viability does not replicate), OR all three guilds are non-zero on 9 or more of 18 (the shortfall was panel-specific and balance is reachable once the accounting is honest).
